email_subject: Application - Online Data Analyst (Dutch speakers in Belgium)
email_body:
Dear TELUS Digital AI Community Team,

I am writing to apply for the Online Data Analyst - Dutch speakers in Belgium role. As a Belgian resident with a strong interest in research and local geography, I am excited by the opportunity to contribute to improving digital maps used worldwide.

My background in digital marketing and web development has given me a sharp eye for detail and extensive experience with online research, search engines, and data verification. I regularly use maps and website information to assess relevance and accuracy, and I am comfortable following guidelines to ensure high-quality results. I am fluent in English and have a good command of Dutch, and I stay up to date with Belgian news, media, and cultural affairs.

I am self-motivated, reliable, and eager to learn. I would welcome the chance to complete the qualification exam and join your global AI Community.

Thank you for your consideration.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear TELUS Digital AI Community Team,

I am excited to apply for the Online Data Analyst - Dutch speakers in Belgium position. As a Belgian resident with a passion for research and a keen understanding of local geography, I am drawn to the opportunity to enhance the quality of digital maps used by millions worldwide.

In my current freelance work in SEO and web development, I conduct detailed online research daily, using search engines, maps, and website information to verify data and assess relevance. For example, I built and optimized mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and ran iterative audits to improve search health. This required meticulous attention to detail and the ability to follow complex guidelines—skills that directly translate to the tasks described in this role. I am fluent in English and have a good command of Dutch, and I regularly follow Belgian news, media, and cultural affairs.

I thrive in independent, self-paced environments and am comfortable with a diverse set of task types, from maps to news and audio. I have daily access to a broadband connection and a computer, and I am eager to complete the qualification exam to demonstrate my suitability.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your AI Community.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Fluent in English and has a good command of Dutch, with deep familiarity with Belgian current affairs, media, and culture.
- Extensive experience in online research, data verification, and relevance assessment using search engines and maps.
- Detail-oriented and adept at following guidelines, as shown by technical SEO audits and structured data implementation.
- Self-motivated freelancer with a strong track record of working independently and managing diverse tasks.
- Daily access to a reliable broadband connection and computer, ready to work from home.
